value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor is hot, with a high of 29 and a humidex of 35. Early on there's a 30% chance of showers and a risk of a thunderstorm, then it clears in the morning. Wind picks up a lot late morning, gusting to around 60 km/h, so secure anything loose outside. Forecast as of this afternoon from Environment Canada.
